```{r}

library(move)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(CircStats)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

out_mp <- leopardseal_all_tracks_mp #this is extracted data from fitted move persistence model for all tracks

move.ls <- move(
  x      = out_mp$lon,
  y      = out_mp$lat,
  time   = out_mp$date,
  proj   = CRS("+proj=longlat +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84"),
  animal = out_mp$id
)

#calculate step lengths
dist.ls <- distance(move.ls)  # step lengths in metres, per individual

# calculate turning angles
ta.ls <- turnAngleGc(move.ls)  # turning angles in degrees, per individual

# Land mask
bg <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")


# Run CRW simulations

n_sims <- 2   # simulated tracks per individual (up to 10k)

set.seed(42) #so random numbers are reproducible (dont use too often)

all_pseudo <- list() #make empty dataset


#Loop 
# [[[[
for (ind_id in namesIndiv(move.ls)) {
  cat("Processing:", ind_id, "\n") #so you can see what seal is being processed
  ind_move <- move.ls[[ind_id]] 
  
  #Step lengths from dist.ls object
  sl <- dist.ls[[ind_id]] / 1000 # metres into km 
  sl <- sl[sl > 0] #remove if step length is 0 

  #Turning angles (degrees) from ta.ls
  ta <- ta.ls[[ind_id]] 
  ta <- ta[!is.na(ta)] #need 3 steps to get an angle, so first and last have none, nas removed

  if (length(sl) < 5 || length(ta) < 5) {
    warning("Skipping ", ind_id, " — too few steps"); next  } #if track too short then next 

  # Fit Gamma distribution to step lengths
  sl_mean  <- mean(sl);  sl_var <- var(sl)
  sl_shape <- sl_mean^2 / sl_var
  sl_rate  <- sl_mean   / sl_var #shape and rate describe how seal moves (eg. short vs fast steps) 

  # Fit von Mises distribution to turning angles (normal distribution for circles)
  ta_rad   <- ta * pi / 180
  ta_kappa <- 1 / (1 - mean(cos(ta_rad))) #kappa describes directionality of seal
  ta_mu    <- atan2(mean(sin(ta_rad)), mean(cos(ta_rad)))

  # Starting location: first real fix for this individual 
  start_lon <- coordinates(ind_move)[1, 1]
  start_lat <- coordinates(ind_move)[1, 2] #extracts first point so all tacks start here
  n_steps   <- n.locs(ind_move) - 1 #all simulated tracks have same number as real track (-1 because no first step) Need this ??? 

  # Simulate n_sims tracks 
  sim_pts <- vector("list", n_sims) #empty list of the right length
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_sims, style = 3) #gives progress bar with percent (style 3)

  for (sim in seq_len(n_sims)) { #outer loop, so repeats all of that n_sims times eg. 10k
    lons    <- numeric(n_steps + 1);  lats <- numeric(n_steps + 1) #creating empty vectors
    lons[1] <- start_lon;             lats[1] <- start_lat #picks random starting direction
    bearing <- runif(1, -pi, pi)

    for (s in seq_len(n_steps)) {
      placed <- FALSE
      for (attempt in seq_len(30)) { #land rejection loop, will try 30 times to find sea then seal stays there
        sl_draw <- rgamma(1, shape = sl_shape, rate = sl_rate)
        ta_draw <- rvm(1, mean = ta_mu, k = ta_kappa)
        bearing <- bearing + ta_draw # draws step length from gamma dist and angle from vonM dist, each step depends on last 

        new_lon <- lons[s] + (sl_draw / (111.32 * cos(lats[s] * pi / 180))) * cos(bearing)
        new_lat <- lats[s] + (sl_draw / 110.57) * sin(bearing) #converts step length and direction into new lat lon

        pt      <- st_sfc(st_point(c(new_lon, new_lat)), crs = 4326)
        on_land <- any(st_intersects(pt, bg, sparse = FALSE)) #rejects points on land

        if (!on_land) {
          lons[s + 1] <- new_lon;  lats[s + 1] <- new_lat
          placed <- TRUE;          break    }  }
      if (!placed) { lons[s + 1] <- lons[s];  lats[s + 1] <- lats[s] } }

    sim_pts[[sim]] <- data.frame(lon = lons[-1], lat = lats[-1]) #stores them 
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, sim) }
  close(pb)

  pseudo_df               <- do.call(rbind, sim_pts)
  pseudo_df$individual_id <- ind_id
  all_pseudo[[ind_id]]    <- pseudo_df
  cat("\n  Done —", nrow(pseudo_df), "pseudo-absence points\n") } #stacks each track per indiv into the df
# ]]]]



# Save results
pseudo_absences <- do.call(rbind, all_pseudo)
write.csv(pseudo_absences, "pseudo_absences.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved pseudo_absences.csv —", nrow(pseudo_absences), "total points\n")


```

Transit rate
```{r}

library(move)

tracks_b <- tracks_vars_behav %>%  filter(presence == 1)



move.ls <- move(
  x      = leopardseal_all_tracks_mp$lon,
  y      = leopardseal_all_tracks_mp$lat,
  time   = leopardseal_all_tracks_mp$date,
  proj   = CRS("+proj=longlat +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84"),
  animal = leopardseal_all_tracks_mp$id)

# Plot the data to check we loaded the correct data
plot(move.ls, xlab="Longitude", ylab="Latitude", type="l", pch=16, lwd=0.5)

#distance
# calculate the distance between locations. Because the units are in degrees (lat, lon), the package move returns the distance in meters
dist.ls <- distance(move.ls)

# Calculate the mean step distance in meters. As these data are interpolated, the step length is giving us transit rate in m/3 hours per id
sapply(dist.ls, mean)

hist(dist.ls$X173719)

#speed
speed.ls <- speed(move.ls) # Speed (or transit rate) in m/s

sapply(speed.ls, mean) # Calculate the mean speed in meters/second per id

hist(speed.ls$X173713)

#convert dist to df

step <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(dist.ls), function(id) {
  data.frame(
    id = id,
    step_length = dist.ls[[id]]
  )}))

step$id <- sub("^X", "", step$id) #so ids match 

step$step_number <- ave(step$step_length, step$id, FUN = seq_along)

leopardseal_all_tracks_mp$step_number <- ave(leopardseal_all_tracks_mp$id, leopardseal_all_tracks_mp$id, FUN = seq_along)

step$step_number <- step$step_number + 1 #shift along 

#merge
leopardseal_mp_steps <- merge(
  leopardseal_all_tracks_mp,
  step[, c("id", "step_number", "step_length")],
  by = c("id", "step_number"),
  all.x = TRUE)

leopardseal_mp_steps$step_number <- as.numeric(leopardseal_mp_steps$step_number)
leopardseal_mp_steps$step_length <- as.numeric(leopardseal_mp_steps$step_length)

leopardseal_mp_steps$step_length_km <- leopardseal_mp_steps$step_length / 1000

hist(leopardseal_mp_steps$step_length_km,
     breaks = 50,
     xlim = c(0, max(43, na.rm = TRUE)))

saveRDS(leopardseal_mp_steps, "leopardseal_mp_steps.rds")


#merge with tracks df

tracks_b <- merge(
  tracks_b,
  leopardseal_mp_steps[, c("id", "lon","lat", "step_length", "step_length_km", "step_number")],
  by = c("id", "lon", "lat"),
  all.x = TRUE)


saveRDS(tracks_b, "tracks_b.rds")


hist(log10(tracks_b$step_length),
     breaks = 50)

boxplot(tracks_b$step_length_km)
hist(tracks_b$step_length_km)


#tracks_b <- tracks_b[, !names(tracks_b) %in% c("change_bin")]
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(colorspace)
library(rnaturalearth)

bg <- ne_countries(scale = "large",returnclass = "sf")

bb <- st_bbox(tracks_b) #bounding box of my data to set the plot to

# all tracks
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bg) +
  geom_sf(data = tracks_b, aes(colour = id)) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"])) +
  scale_fill_hypso_d('wiki-2.0_hypso') 

#gradient
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bg) +
  geom_sf(data = tracks_b , aes(colour=step_length)) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"])) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c()

#binary 
tracks_b$step_bin <- ifelse(tracks_b$step_length > 20000, 1, 0)


# just one track 
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bg) +
  geom_sf(data = tracks_b[tracks_b$id == 173717, ] , aes(colour=step_length)) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"])) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c()
   # indiv has grouping around coast and then movement out towards island



hist(tracks_b$step_length,
     breaks = 50,
     xlab = "Step length (m)",
     main = "Step length distribution")



# track with joining lines 

library(dplyr)

track <- tracks_b |>
  filter(id == 173717) |>
  arrange(date)

track_line <- track |>
  summarise(do_union = FALSE) |>
  st_cast("LINESTRING")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bg) +
  geom_sf(data = track_line, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = track, 
          aes(colour = step_length), size = 2) +
    coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"]))+
  scale_colour_viridis_c()


# all tracks with binary
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bg) +
  geom_sf(data = tracks_b, aes(colour = step_bin)) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"]))


# check bin on other indivs

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bg) +
  geom_sf(data = tracks_b[tracks_b$id == 173717, ] , aes(colour=step_bin)) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"]))
```
